# Wisely Chen — AI Coding 實戰筆記

> AI Agent、地端 LLM 部署與企業 AI 架構的生產實測紀錄

## About

This site documents production-tested AI-assisted software development practices by Wisely Chen, an AI engineering consultant with 50+ production AI projects. Content covers the ATPM framework (Assessment, Testing, Program, Management), local-first LLM deployment, agent harness engineering, and enterprise AI architecture — with quantified results from real projects.

- Author: Wisely Chen
- URL: https://ai-coding.wiselychen.com
- Language: Traditional Chinese (繁體中文), select articles in English
- Total articles: 330+
- Update frequency: Daily
- Topics: AI Agent, Vibe Coding, ATPM Framework, Local LLM Deployment, Harness Engineering, Enterprise AI, Open Weights Models, KV Cache Economics, AI Security

## Key Frameworks

- ATPM (Assessment, Testing, Program, Management): 40% development time reduction, PRD:Code ratio 1:1.4
- Three-Layer AI Collaboration: Embed → Copilot → Agent (2023–2025 evolution)
- Silicon Valley Quality Control: 4-layer review pipeline
